channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Welsh Water set to pay £44.7m over 'serious and unacceptable' breaches
item.description: Welsh Water is set to pay £44.7 million over “serious and unacceptable” breaches in the supplier’s sewage and network services.

item.title: ‘We are human' - Amber Davies forced off stage mid‑show after falling ill
item.description: Denbighshire performer Amber Davies has stepped back from her role in Legally Blonde after falling ill mid‑show, telling fans she is battling a “lingering illness” and burnout just days after winning a major musical theatre award.

item.title: Prison for 'evil' man who coerced person into not having COVID vaccine
item.description: A man from Gwynedd who inflicted “atrocities” on another person has been jailed.

item.title: North Wales woman stranded in 'manic' Thailand as US-Iran conflict closes airspace
item.description: A woman from Abergele has been left stranded in Thailand as the ongoing US-Iran conflict continues to affect British residents abroad.

item.title: BBC Wales to hold Llandudno Q&A with party leaders ahead of Senedd election 2026
item.description: Ahead of the Senedd Election in May, BBC Wales is holding two Your Voice Live: Ask the Leader programmes featuring six party leaders.

item.title: Colwyn Bay guest house owner recognised on She Inspires Impact Leaders List
item.description: The list is a curated editorial recognition of 100 women whose leadership is shaping measurable outcomes. It is not a nomination-based list.

item.title: Claims illegal tobacco hidden in crisp boxes at Llandudno shop’s licence hearing
item.description: Trading Standards officers told a Conwy licensing committee that illegal tobacco had been found hidden in crisp boxes and that children in school uniforms had been sold age‑restricted products, as Cece Mini Market sought permission to sell alcohol from 8am to 11pm.

item.title: Council's new proposed plans for 30mph speed limits across region
item.description: Conwy County Borough Council proposes to implement new 30mph speed limits across various roads.

item.title: ‘No investment in Towyn’ says amusement park owner as petition launched
item.description: A petition urging more investment and improved infrastructure in Towyn has been created by a town councillor and amusement park owner.

item.title: Aldi is recruiting store staff at sites in these two North Wales towns
item.description: Aldi is actively recruiting 280 store colleagues across Wales - including at sites in two North Wales towns.
